name: cate.deepwiki
description: DeepWiki (DeepWiki-Open) as a server-backed Cate extension: reverse-proxies a user-run DeepWiki instance and adds Cate-native code-reference links + theming + provider reuse.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:panel && node ./copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
